Garmin export flow

MTL Explorer runs two community helpers from GarminExporter. The exporter ensures the configured helper version/profile is installed, writes the known activity-ID exclusion file, then starts the primary GPX export.

flowchart TD
    server[GarminExporter] --> primary[run_export.sh: versioned gcexport]
    primary --> garmin[Garmin Connect]
    primary --> output[Exported GPX files]
    server --> retry[Selected GPX download errors]
    retry --> fit[run_fit_export.sh: profile-specific environment]
    fit --> garmin
    fit --> conversion[FIT to GPX conversion]
    conversion --> output
    output --> watcher[GPS watcher and normal indexing]
On this page
  • Helper interfaces
  • Failure handling

Helper interfaces

Helper Arguments Environment
garmin_export/run_export.sh username, password, exclude file, gcexport version venv_gcexport_<version> and gcexport_src_<version>
garmin_fit_export/run_fit_export.sh username, password, activity ID, save directory, optional profile (default default) venv_fit_<profile>

install_gcexport.sh and install_fit_export.sh create the corresponding environments during the image build or through runtime tool management. The Dockerfile owns default versions and packages.

The primary wrapper exports into its versioned source directory, then copies GARMIN_CONNECT_EXPORTED_TRACKS without overwriting existing files into /app/gpx/. This path is currently fixed in the wrapper. The standard Compose watcher instead uses /app/mtl-data/gpx; Garmin setup therefore needs the additional mount described in Garmin setup.

The FIT fallback uses mtl.garmin-sync.fit-export-save-dir, set to the watched directory by Compose. It retains activity_<id>.fit and writes activity_<id>.gpx. See the FIT helper.

Failure handling

The intended fallback is a failed GPX download, commonly a timeout. The current parser actually selects log lines matching \[ERROR\].*?gpx/activity/(\d+); it does not require the text 408. It deduplicates the captured IDs and retries them through FIT export. A generic error with no matching activity URL cannot select an activity for retry. FIT requests can also fail.

The server captures helper output and reports export duration, retry results, and errors. A completed export and completed indexing are separate milestones. Open Settings → Import & sync → Garmin for command output and Settings → Processing for indexing. Helper installation controls are under Settings → Maintenance → Advanced tools.

Sync remains optional and disabled by default. Configure credentials privately; the Garmin setup guide describes the required configuration and mounts.
